comparison.objective: Route a connected cable between posts and secure its final clip while preserving an existing fixing, versus tune a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually manipulate an articulated wire, route it around obstacles, and seat it in a spring clip.
comparison.success_condition: Correct route, both clips retained, required hand participation, release, clearance, and low wire speed; separation or upstream release fails.
comparison.reason: Cable routing and compliant-object retention are meaningfully different from precision rotary adjustment and dynamic commissioning.
